```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
target AS (
    SELECT product_id AS pid
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number = 'HB-T721'
),
part AS (
    SELECT product_id AS pid
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number = 'MS-0253'
),
current_bom AS (
    SELECT assembly_id, component_id, per_assembly_qty
    FROM bill_of_materials
    WHERE assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= end_date)
),
explosion AS (
    SELECT b.assembly_id, b.component_id, b.per_assembly_qty AS qty
    FROM current_bom b
    JOIN target t ON b.assembly_id = t.pid

    UNION ALL

    SELECT e.assembly_id, b.component_id, e.qty * b.per_assembly_qty AS qty
    FROM explosion e
    JOIN product p
      ON e.component_id = p.product_id
     AND p.make_flag = TRUE
    JOIN current_bom b
      ON b.assembly_id = e.component_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.qty), 0) AS required_qty
FROM explosion e
JOIN part pt
  ON e.component_id = pt.pid;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
  dates(label, d) AS (
    VALUES ('earlier', DATE '2021-10-16'), ('current', DATE '2025-06-30')
  ),
  root AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'BK-R89B-44'
  ),
  target AS (

  ),
  bom_tree(label, component_id, qty) AS (
    SELECT d.label, b.component_id, b.per_assembly_qty
    FROM dates d
    CROSS JOIN root r
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = r.product_id
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= d.d
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR d.d <= b.end_date)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT t.label, b.component_id, t.qty * b.per_assembly_qty
    FROM bom_tree t
    JOIN dates d ON d.label = t.label
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = t.component_id AND p.make_flag = TRUE
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = t.component_id
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= d.d
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR d.d <= b.end_date)

  totals AS (
    SELECT bt.label, COALESCE(SUM(bt.qty), 0) AS qty
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN target tg ON tg.product_id = bt.component_id
    GROUP BY bt.label
  )
SELECT

  - COALESCE((SELECT qty FROM totals WHERE label = 'earlier'), 0) AS change;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_expand(order_id, line_id, order_date, root_code, node_code, qty, path) AS (
  SELECT
    sol.order_id,
    sol.line_id,
    so.order_date,
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
dates(label, d) AS (
    VALUES
        ('earlier', DATE '2021-08-10'),
        ('current', DATE '2025-06-30')
),
bom(label, d, child_code, qty, path) AS (
    SELECT
        d.label,
        d.d,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty,
        list_value(c.parent_code, c.child_code)
    FROM dates d
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_code = 'BK-M18S-44'
     AND c.valid_from <= d.d
     AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR d.d <= c.valid_to)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.label,
        b.d,
        c.child_code,
        b.qty * c.qty,
        list_append(b.path, c.child_code)
    FROM bom b
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_code = b.child_code
     AND c.valid_from <= b.d
     AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR b.d <= c.valid_to)
    JOIN product p
      ON p.product_number = b.child_code
    WHERE p.make_flag = TRUE
      AND NOT list_contains(b.path, c.child_code)
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        label,
        COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total_qty
    FROM bom
    WHERE child_code = 'SH-4562'
    GROUP BY label
)
SELECT
    COALESCE((SELECT total_qty FROM totals WHERE label = 'current'), 0)
    - COALESCE((SELECT total_qty FROM totals WHERE label = 'earlier'), 0) AS change;
```

```sql
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st

      AND so.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total_demand
FROM (
    SELECT order_qty AS qty
    FROM central_2025_lines
    WHERE product_number = 'MS-2348'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT l.order_qty * e.qty AS qty
    FROM central_2025_lines l
    JOIN u_explosion e
      ON e.root_code = l.product_number
     AND e.item_code = 'MS-2348'
     AND e.valid_from <= l.order_date
     AND (e.valid_to IS NULL OR l.order_date <= e.valid_to)
) demand;
```

```sql
WITH qtys AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
         AND (valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= valid_to)
        THEN qty
      END
    ), 0) AS current_qty,
    COALESCE(SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN valid_from <= DATE '2021-10-16'
         AND (valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2021-10-16' <= valid_to)
        THEN qty
      END
    ), 0) AS earlier_qty

)
SELECT current_qty - earlier_qty AS change
FROM qtys;
```
